title: The Blueprint Nobody Built
title_ja: 建てられなかった建物の設計図
fact_notes: 人物、具体的な出来事・実験・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査や統計の結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: While helping at a small town archive, Leo found a drawing of a large public building that he had never seen before.
sentences.ja: 小さな町の資料館を手伝っていたレオは、見たことのない大きな公共施設の図面を見つけた。

sentences.en: The drawing included a wide entrance, several meeting rooms, and a garden in the center.
sentences.ja: 図面には広い入口、複数の会議室、中央の庭が描かれていた。

sentences.en: A date written in one corner showed that the plan was several decades old.
sentences.ja: 隅に記された日付から計画が数十年前のものだと分かった。

sentences.en: Leo assumed that the building had once stood somewhere in the town and had later been destroyed.
sentences.ja: レオは建物がかつて町にあり、後に取り壊されたと思った。

sentences.en: However, the archivist explained that a drawing was not necessarily evidence that a building had existed.
sentences.ja: しかし資料館の職員は図面が建物の存在を示す証拠とは限らないと説明した。

sentences.en: She encouraged Leo to search for other documents connected with the project.
sentences.ja: 職員は計画に関連する別の文書を探すよう促した。

sentences.en: Together, they discovered a set of meeting notes and a list of estimated construction costs.
sentences.ja: 二人は会議の記録と建設費の見積もり一覧を発見した。

sentences.en: They also found letters discussing whether the town should spend its limited funds on the building.
sentences.ja: 限られた資金を建物に使うべきか議論した手紙も見つけた。

sentences.en: The records revealed that some residents had supported the project because they wanted a shared meeting space.
sentences.ja: 記録から、一部の住民は共用の集会場所を望み計画を支持していたことが分かった。

sentences.en: Others had argued that improving the existing roads was more urgent.
sentences.ja: 別の住民は既存の道路の改善の方が緊急だと主張していた。

sentences.en: Eventually, the council postponed the building project and never returned to the original proposal.
sentences.ja: 結局、議会は建設計画を延期し、元の提案に戻ることはなかった。

sentences.en: The ambitious design had therefore remained only on paper.
sentences.ja: そのため、意欲的な設計は紙の上だけに残った。

sentences.en: Leo was surprised that an unrealized project could reveal so much about the town's past.
sentences.ja: レオは実現しなかった計画が町の過去について多くを明らかにすることに驚いた。

sentences.en: He prepared an exhibition that presented the drawing alongside the competing proposals.
sentences.ja: 彼は対立する提案と並べて図面を展示する企画を用意した。

sentences.en: Visitors were invited to consider which decision they might have made under similar circumstances.
sentences.ja: 来場者は同じような状況で自分ならどの決断をしたか考えるよう求められた。

sentences.en: The exhibition encouraged discussion instead of presenting the past as a series of inevitable events.
sentences.ja: 展示は過去を必然的な出来事の連続として示す代わりに議論を促した。

sentences.en: By the time the exhibition opened, Leo had changed his understanding of historical evidence.
sentences.ja: 展示が始まる頃、レオは史料への理解を変えていた。

sentences.en: He realized that documents can preserve hopes and disagreements as well as completed actions.
sentences.ja: 文書には実行された行動だけでなく希望や対立も残ると気づいた。

sentences.en: Studying abandoned plans can help people understand the choices that earlier generations faced.
sentences.ja: 中止された計画を調べることで以前の世代が直面した選択を理解できる。

sentences.en: The building that never existed had become an important part of his town's story.
sentences.ja: 存在しなかった建物が町の物語の重要な一部になった。

questions.prompt: Where did Leo find the old drawing?
questions.explanation_ja: 町の資料館で見つけた。

options: The building had existed and been destroyed.
The drawing had been made the day before.
The archive was located in the building.
questions.explanation_ja: 建物が実在し後に取り壊されたと思った。

questions.prompt: Why did the archivist suggest finding other records?
options: She wanted Leo to draw a new plan.
The building had been photographed already.
A design alone does not prove construction occurred.
questions.explanation_ja: 図面だけでは実在を証明できない。

questions.prompt: What additional documents did they discover?
options: A visitor's ticket and a menu.
Meeting notes and estimated construction costs.
A modern painting and a map.
questions.explanation_ja: 会議記録と建設費の見積もりを発見した。

questions.prompt: What alternative did some residents support?
questions.explanation_ja: 道路改善の方が緊急だと主張した。

questions.prompt: What happened to the building plan?
options: It was postponed and never revived.
It was completed within a year.
It was moved to a nearby town.
questions.explanation_ja: 延期されたまま再開されなかった。

questions.prompt: What does ambitious most nearly mean here?
questions.explanation_ja: 意欲的で実現に大きな努力を要する。

questions.prompt: What did Leo display alongside the drawing?
options: A model of the finished building.
questions.explanation_ja: 対立する提案も展示した。

questions.prompt: Why were visitors asked what they might have decided?
options: To reflect on past choices and alternatives.
To vote on a current election.
To choose a new exhibition date.
questions.explanation_ja: 当時あり得た選択肢を考えるため。

options: Only completed buildings matter to historians.
All old proposals should be carried out today.
Unrealized plans can also provide historical evidence.
questions.explanation_ja: 実現しなかった計画も歴史の理解に役立つ。

grammar.explanation_ja: 過去完了は思った時点より前の存在を表す。
not necessarilyは必ずしも〜ではない。
比較級で優先度を比較する。
as well asは〜だけでなくもという意味。

discourse.role_ja: 最初の思い込みに対する修正。
議論の最終的な結果を示す。
展示の方針を対比する。
